rules.statement: The principle of estoppel does not apply in respect of an identical issue in different financial years, and the doctrine of res judicata is not applicable in tax matters.
rules.supporting_quote: It is the view of this Court that the general rule that has been applied over many years is that the principle of estoppel does not apply in respect of an identical issue in different financial years and the doctrine of res judicata is not applicable in tax matters.
